mapper.select: select bs.id, bs.user_id as userId, bs.book_id as bookId, bi.book_name as bookName, bi.cover_url as coverUrl, bs.last_read_chapter_id as lastReadChapterId, bs.last_read_time as lastReadTime from book_shelf as bs join book_info bi on bs.book_id = bi.id where bs.user_id = #{userId} order by bs.update_time desc
